added: Settings ▸ Defaults ▸ Import defaults lets you choose tags that are added automatically to each new dance you import on its own, such as a "no card" tag. Dances created while importing a program, restored from a Compendium archive, or updated by a re-import are not tagged.
`ImportPipeline.commit`, `CallersCompanionUsrImporter.commit` and `PublishedCollectionImporter.commit` accept `defaultTagIds`, added to the dances the commit creates.
